name: Legends: Saint George
source:
Delve into the myth of Saint George and the Dragon in a unique interactive experience.

In Legends: Saint George, your decisions will determine the fate of the legendary knight and that distant kingdom.

Will you save the princess? Will you defeat the dragon? Or will you cross paths with legendary characters such as Don Quixote or Joan of Arc and join forces with them?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3746100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在独特的互动体验中深入了解圣乔治和龙的神话。

在《传奇：圣乔治》中，你的决定将决定传奇骑士和那个遥远王国的命运。

你会拯救公主吗？你会打败龙吗？或者你会与堂吉诃德或圣女贞德等传奇人物相遇并与他们联手？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3746100/]Steam[/url]]
